summary: Verified the 'real bracket order at entry' risk-management fix (server.py POST /api/orders, auto_trader_service.py execute_entry/sell_with_retry). Backend: full pytest suite 207 passed / 5 failed on first run (all failures were transient/pre-existing and non-reproducible on isolated re-run - 2 deprecated websocket tests as documented, 1 live-data news-sentiment mislabel unrelated to this change, 1 ReadTimeout and 1 gateway-timeout that both passed cleanly on re-run in isolation). test_bracket_order_at_entry.py: 5/5 passed both standalone and re-run. Live curl verification confirmed: buy with stop_type='trailing' now returns order_class:'bracket' with a real resting stop-loss leg on Alpaca (confirmed via GET /api/orders?status=open showing a 'new' sell order immediately after buy); GET /api/positions/monitored still shows dynamic trailing-stop fields (current_stop, highest_price, partial_sold) confirming the software layer is still active on top of the bracket. HOWEVER found a REAL REGRESSION during the buy->sell round-trip test explicitly requested: selling shortly after a bracket buy is NOT clean as required - it returns HTTP 409 or 500 instead of succeeding.

critical.endpoint: POST /api/orders (sell, immediately after a bracket buy)
critical.issue: Selling within ~10s of a bracket buy fails. Two reproduced failure modes via live curl: (1) Sell attempted before the parent BUY order itself has filled (0s gap) -> raw Alpaca rejection surfaces as HTTP 500 'cannot open a short sell while a long buy order is open' (position_monitor._sell_with_dedup finds no existing SELL order yet since only the BUY is still open, so it passes straight through to place_market_order with no guard for an open BUY on the same symbol). (2) Sell attempted 1-9s after the buy fills (bracket's stop-loss leg now resting as a fresh 'new' sell order) -> _sell_with_dedup sees an existing SELL order that is < stale_after_seconds(10s) old and returns None, which server.py turns into HTTP 409 'A sell order for X is already pending - please wait a few seconds and retry.' Waiting past the 10s staleness window makes the sell succeed cleanly (cancels the stale bracket leg, sells, position flattens correctly) - confirmed working. RCA: _sell_with_dedup was designed to dedupe genuinely-duplicate in-flight manual sell clicks, but now every bracket buy ALSO leaves its own resting stop-loss sell order, which this same logic misidentifies as 'a sell already pending' and blocks/delays a legitimate new sell for up to 10 seconds. This directly contradicts the review request's explicit expectation: 'verify it succeeds cleanly ... No 409/500 errors expected.'

integration_issues.flow: Quick Trade Panel / Trading.js Sell button shortly after Buy
integration_issues.issue: Since QuickTradePanel.js and Trading.js both post to the same /api/orders endpoint with no client-side awareness of the resting bracket leg, a user who buys then sells within ~10 seconds (plausible with the 1/2 or SELL ALL buttons right after a fresh buy, or on a fast position-flip decision) will see a toast error ('Sell X failed: A sell order for X is already pending...') instead of a successful sell, even though they have not previously attempted to sell.

action_items: Fix _sell_with_dedup (position_monitor_service.py) and/or the manual sell path in server.py to distinguish 'a resting bracket stop-loss/take-profit leg for THIS position' from 'a genuinely duplicate in-flight manual sell order' - e.g. force-cancel any resting order class=bracket child leg immediately (no 10s staleness wait, no reliance on catching an 'insufficient qty' exception) before placing a manual sell, mirroring the force-cancel-and-retry pattern already implemented in auto_trader_service.sell_with_retry().

rca_of_the_issue: The fix correctly adds a real resting bracket stop-loss/take-profit order at buy time (closing the original user-reported gap), but did not update the existing manual-sell dedup guard (_sell_with_dedup, originally built to prevent double-submitting sells while an earlier sell was still resting) to account for the fact that now EVERY buy also leaves its own resting SELL order (the bracket's stop leg). That guard's 10-second staleness window treats this brand-new bracket leg as an indistinguishable 'duplicate sell in flight' and blocks/delays any real sell attempt for up to 10 seconds after buying, surfacing as 409 to the end user; an even faster sell attempt (before the parent buy itself fills) hits a raw unhandled Alpaca rejection surfaced as 500.
